_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Yɛrɛ Player {player_id} kɔm Liar's Dice kɛlɛ la {num_players} jugɛrɛ.
Laasɛ:
- Nɛ yɛrɛ wɛɛlɛ, yɛrɛ pɔsɛ:
  1) Kɛlɛ kɔm bid kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kɔlɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ '[Call]'.

Yɛrɛ kɔlɛ:
  - Yɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ face value kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ bid la, kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ bidder kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.
  - Lɛɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ, kɔlɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.
Jugɛrɛ yɛrɛ 0 dice kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ, yɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ.

board.new_round:
Kɛlɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ - Dice kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ: {dice_summary}
Yɛrɛ Dice kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kɔlɛ! Face {face_value} kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ {count}, yɛrɛ LESS kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ bidder) kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kɔlɛ! Face {face_value} kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ {count}, yɛrɛ >= kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (kɔlɛrɛ) kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: B sẽn bool-a wã pa yɩ ne ligd ye.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kɛlɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ '[Bid: X, Y]' yɛrɛ '[Call]'. Kɛlɛ wɛɛlɛ: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Face kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {new_face_value} yɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: B sẽn kõ ligd ningã zemsa ne b sẽn da kõt rũnda wã.
